exposure: Adherence to Safe Prevention of the Primary Cesarean Delivery 2014 criteria
cohort: 206 women with term, live, singleton deliveries and intrapartum primary cesarean delivery solely for failed induction of labor or labor arrest
finding: The majority of cesarean deliveries performed for labor arrest disorders were not adherent to the Safe Prevention of the Primary Cesarean Delivery 2014 guidelines, despite recent guidelines aimed to reduce the primary cesarean delivery rate.
